title: Nationally, Food & Beverages rose most in 2019–2024 at 16.5%, compared with transport at 6.7% and housing/utilities/fuels at 6.4%.
subtitle: CPI division price changes (%), annual-average 2019–2024; Malaysia and 16 states; original index 2010 = 100
source: CC BY 4.0, DOSM; cpi_state: https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/cpi_state (https://storage.dosm.gov.my/cpi/cpi_2d_state.csv); cpi_headline: https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/cpi_headline (https://storage.dosm.gov.my/cpi/cpi_2d.csv); mcoicop: https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/mcoicop (https://storage.dosm.gov.my/dictionaries/mcoicop.csv)
notes: Division names come from the official 2-digit MCOICOP lookup, not guessed labels.
National CPI is official national data, not an unweighted state average.
Category price growth is not its contribution to overall inflation; basket weights are not analysed.
headline: Nationally, Food & Beverages rose most in 2019–2024 at 16.5%, compared with transport at 6.7% and housing/utilities/fuels at 6.4%. These are annual-average category price changes, not inflation contributions.
